wave_name: UI Implementation (Auth + Dashboard + Map + Messages + Stress)
goal: Build all user-facing pages and components with Tailwind + shadcn/ui and wire them to the existing API + Socket.io contracts for real-time interactions.

depends_on_outputs_from: AuthenticationAgent: Auth.js session working + middleware protection
RealTimeSocketAgent: socket events and connection requirements

tasks.title: Auth pages (login + register) with Zod validation
steps: Create /app/(auth)/login/page.tsx as a client component form
Validate inputs on submit using UserLoginSchema.safeParse
Display field-level errors next to inputs
Call Auth.js signIn('credentials', ...)
Create /app/(auth)/register/page.tsx with UserRegisterSchema client validation
Call POST /api/auth/register then redirect to login or auto sign-in
verification: Register and login work end-to-end in browser
Invalid inputs show Zod-driven field errors

tasks.title: Protected layout + navigation
steps: Create /app/(protected)/layout.tsx
Implement Navbar and/or Sidebar in /components/layout
Show session user info (safe fields only)
Add navigation links: Dashboard, Map, Messages, Stress
verification: Protected routes render only when authenticated (middleware enforced)

tasks.title: Socket client hook
steps: Create /hooks/useSocket.ts as a client hook
Connect to Socket.io server using auth token strategy consistent with server middleware
Implement auto-reconnect and cleanup on unmount
Expose on(event, handler) and emit(event, payload)
Type event names and payloads to avoid stringly-typed usage
verification: Socket connects successfully when logged in

tasks.title: Dashboard + Map page with nearby drivers
steps: Create /app/(protected)/dashboard/page.tsx
Create /app/(protected)/map/page.tsx
Implement driver marker/list UI and selection UI
Subscribe to nearby_driver_update and render updated nearby drivers
Request browser geolocation, then emit update_location periodically (15–30s) or on change
Add DriverCard component for selected driver and action buttons
verification: Two users see each other on the map/nearby list when close
UI updates in real time on movement

tasks.title: Messages page (record + send + inbox)
steps: Create /app/(protected)/messages/page.tsx
Render inbox by calling GET /api/voice-messages
Use useVoiceRecorder to record audio, upload audio via POST /api/upload/audio, then send via POST /api/voice-messages or socket send_voice_message
Add VoiceMessageItem component with audio playback
On play, call PATCH /api/voice-messages/[id]/status to mark listened
Subscribe to voice_message_received socket event and show toast/inbox refresh
verification: User can record, send, and receiver can play message
Receiver gets real-time notification and message appears in inbox

tasks.title: Stress page (trigger + active alerts)
steps: Create /app/(protected)/stress/page.tsx
Add large red stress button (floating if desired) that sends stress signal (socket event or POST API)
Render list of active signals using GET /api/stress-signals/active
Subscribe to stress_signal_alert socket event and show toast + update UI
Add StressSignalBadge component for alert display
verification: Sending stress signal triggers real-time alert for nearby users
Active signals list updates and shows only valid active signals

tasks.title: Mobile-first UI polish using shadcn/ui
steps: Ensure all pages are usable at 375px width
Use shadcn/ui components consistently (Button, Card, Dialog, Badge, Input, etc.)
Add toast notifications (Sonner) for socket events
Avoid heavy UI libraries beyond shadcn/ui
outputs: Consistent UI styling across all pages
verification: No layout breakage on mobile viewport

must_provide: Routes list and how to navigate
How to run two-user test in browser
Notes on socket connection/auth approach used on client

integration_checkpoint.name: Checkpoint F — UI Gate
must_pass: Protected pages inaccessible when logged out (middleware enforced)
Map page shows nearby drivers and updates in real time
Voice messaging works end-to-end with record/upload/send/play/listened status
Stress signal triggers real-time alerts and appears on UI
manual_verification: Open two separate browser sessions (incognito + normal) as Driver A and Driver B; validate the full workflow

stop_condition_to_advance: Full end-to-end workflow works in UI with real-time updates and no runtime errors.
